title: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Mayrhofen
highlights: Glaeserne Schaumanufaktur zur traditionellen Verarbeitung von Heumilch zu edlem Bergkaese
Interaktive Verkostungsstationen mit feinsten Zillertaler Kaese- und Joghurtspezialitaeten
Grosser Schaubauernhof mit Kuehen, Ziegen, Schafen und eigenem Bienenhaus
Sennereikueche mit traditionellen Zillertaler Schmankerln und sonniger Terrasse
kurzbeschreibung: The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen showcases the processing of pure hay milk inside a glass-fronted dairy and offers tastings.
beschreibung:
Culinary Culture and Honest Craftsmanship

At the ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen, everything revolves around the time-honored refinement of purest Tyrolean hay milk. From glass viewing galleries, visitors look directly into the production halls and observe how fresh milk matures into flavorful Zillertaler Graukäse and Bergkäse.

Show Farm and Culinary Delights

On the adjoining show farm, guests can meet the animals that supply the milk and gain fascinating insights into sustainable circular agriculture. Tasting stations and the on-site Sennereiküche invite visitors to savor the award-winning delicacies fresh from production.
